description: Données Ouvertes sur les Transport Ferroviaire - Établissements au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Transports. Les données sur les établissements du transport ferroviaire au Togo fournissent des informations essentielles sur les infrastructures liées au réseau ferroviaire. Elles incluent la localisation des établissements, leur type, leur état, ainsi que leur capacité. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Transports. Its tags are etablissements, ferroviaire, transport, transport-ferroviaire. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
